SELECT Template_ID, Template_Type_Code
FROM Templates
WHERE Template_ID IN (
    SELECT Document_ID
    FROM Documents
)
GROUP BY Template_ID, Template_Type_Code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
